context: End-to-end assurance/recovery of Powerhouse health after user requested every red state become green.
observations: 32/32 intelligence layers and 18/18 required jobs can be active while overall architecture/content health is still non-green.
Required source freshness, structural lineage, terminal obligations and external outcome/readback must be evaluated independently.
A single provider quota/outage must not block provider-neutral external-intelligence capability when another governed approved source is fresh.
Legacy Buffer telemetry must not remain a required green gate after publication authority moved to canonical Composio/Meta routes.
Already-published LinkedIn side effects with provider acknowledgement and republish_forbidden must never be duplicated merely because readback permission is degraded.
Instagram Mira publication requires exact asset proof plus temporal start/middle/end evidence; generated media alone is not publication proof.
prevention_rules: Never promote GREEN from wiring/activity alone.
Never synthesize source observations or business outcomes.
Keep provider-specific telemetry visible but gate whole-Brain health on provider-neutral capability contracts.
Retired tooling is telemetry-only unless explicitly re-authorized as canonical.
Repair lineage prospectively in the existing canonical tables/functions; do not create parallel stores.
Recompute central health only after read-after-write evidence.
truth_boundary: This learning records verified operating rules and observed architecture behavior; it does not assert all current health is green.
